Subject: BetaCloud economics sync — cache hit assumptions and target $/1M tokens

Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we can align on a pricing model that matches BetaCloud's expected growth.

Recap (what we heard)
- Current baseline: ~600M tokens / month today (mixed traffic: UI+API).
- Growth expectation: 1.8–2.0x over next 6 months (planning for ~1.1–1.2B tokens/month).
- Peak characteristics: short chat sessions dominate (high prefix reuse), spikes during batch jobs for analytics.
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 300ms for UI paths; some API batches can tolerate 1–2s.

What BetaCloud asked us to prioritize
- A target effective unit cost (target $/1M tokens) range to evaluate ROI vs. incumbent.
- Sensitivity table for different cache hit rates (30% / 45% / 60%) and a short description of the prefix cache strategy that yields each hit rate.
- Any latency or operational trade-offs tied to the cache approach.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the 600M baseline and expected 6-month horizon for 1.1–1.2B tokens? If different, please reply with updated monthly tokens.
2) We’ll send a short workbook with modeled scenarios (30/45/60% overall hit) by EOD. Please confirm procurement contact for pricing/PO cadence (I’ve cc’d procurement in case they want to jump in).
3) If you have any hard budget bands (e.g., target < $750/1M tokens), flag that now so we can prioritize compression/quantization recommendations.

Callouts for our internal team (Ben / Marissa) — please prepare a concise workbook that:
- Shows effective $/1M at the three hit-rate points using BetaCloud's baseline,
- Includes a short appendix describing prefix cache (TTL, warm pools, per-customer caching) and operational impacts on latency,
- Highlights opportunities to hit low-cost bands (e.g., model variant routing + 8-bit quantization) and any expected quality delta.

Thanks — will align on timing after Samir confirms the baseline.

Questions

2) Can you include both an authz/privacy-safe shared prefix cache (cross-tenant) and a per-tenant warm cache scenario? We expect some customers will not allow cross-tenant reuse.
3) Latency sensitivity: any scenario that increases 95th by >50ms needs to be flagged (UI team is strict).

Procurement: procurement@betacloud.com — we are open to a 12-month committed capacity contract if numbers land in our internal target. Need a worksheet we can attach to the internal finance review.

Appreciate you turning this around quickly.

Samir / Karthik / Marissa — attached is the populated workbook (beta_cache_model_estimates.xlsx). High-level summary below so procurement has numbers they can use in the finance review.

Assumptions (brief)
- Raw backend cost (no caching, standard model variant mix, some quantization): $1,400 per 1M tokens (this is our internal cost before any discounts/commits).
- Prefix + KV cache reduces billed compute proportional to cache hit rate. We model: 30% / 45% / 60% effective hit on billed tokens.
- Additional ops/infra overhead for caching (~8% cost uplift) included in effective numbers.
- We modeled both cross-tenant shared prefix and per-tenant warm-pool; numbers below assume conservative per-tenant warm pools (lower hit by ~5 percentage points vs shared).

Snapshot: effective $/1M tokens (per scenario)
- 30% hit -> $980 / 1M tokens
- 45% hit -> $680 / 1M tokens
- 60% hit -> $510 / 1M tokens

Notes:
- To hit target < $750/1M, BetaCloud needs at least ~45% effective hit under the per-tenant warm-pool model, or ~40% if they allow shared prefix reuse.
- Latency impact: warm pools add ~10–20ms median for first-token lookups; 95th remains within the 300ms SLO in our tests for UI paths (we'll include a microbenchmark in appendix).
- If BetaCloud commits to a 12-month reserved capacity at the 1.0B token band, we can offer an additional ~12% price credit on the numbers above — details in the workbook.

Deliverables attached: beta_cache_model_estimates.xlsx (worksheets: summary, assumptions, per-tenant-vs-shared, latency-microbench). I also attached a short commercial scope memo (beta_scope_MA_v1.docx) for legal/procurement.

Let me know if you want a one-page PDF we can drop into your finance packet. Happy to hop on a brief call to walk through the sheet.
